# react-socket

> TypeScript-first WebSocket library for React, published on npm as `@luciodale/react-socket`. Twelve hooks over one `WebSocketManager`: typed message unions, automatic reconnection with backoff, ref-counted subscriptions, in-flight/ack tracking, keep-alive, and an offline send queue.

- Install: `npm install @luciodale/react-socket`
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luciodale/react-socket
- Source: https://github.com/luciodale/react-socket
- Docs: https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket
- Author: Lucio D'Alessandro (https://koolcodez.com)
- License: MIT. Peer dependency: React 18+. Zero runtime dependencies.

Also searched as: react socket, react websocket hook, react web socket client, typescript websocket library for react, useWebSocket alternative.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/getting-started): What react-socket is, install, first manager and hooks.
- [Configuration](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/configuration): Every `WebSocketManager` option — url, serialize/deserialize, discriminator, heartbeat, reconnect tuning, `beforeConnect`, `getAckId`, `getSubscriptionResolvedKey`.
- [API Reference](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/api): All twelve hooks, manager methods, and exported types.

## Guides

- [Patterns](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/patterns): Recipes for chat, presence, streaming LLM output, and request/response over a socket.
- [Subscriptions](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/subscriptions): Ref-counted channel subscriptions that dedupe across components and restore on reconnect.
- [Sending & Optimistic UI](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/optimistic-updates): Send intents, ack ids, and rendering optimistically before the server confirms.
- [Reconnection](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/reconnection): Exponential backoff with jitter, attempt caps, and subscription restore.
- [Authentication](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/auth): Token in the URL via `beforeConnect`, or first-message auth via `onReady`.
- [Error handling](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/error-handling): `useSocketSendFailed`, in-flight drops, and terminal disconnects.
- [Testing](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/testing): The `@luciodale/react-socket/testing` fake transport.
- [Undelivered Sync](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/undelivered-sync): Persisting sends made while offline and flushing them on reconnect.

## Advanced

- [Backpressure](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/backpressure): `useSocketEventBatch` for high-frequency streams.
- [Binary frames](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/binary): ArrayBuffer/Blob payloads and custom codecs.
- [Monitoring](https://koolcodez.com/projects/react-socket/docs/monitoring): `onDebug` events and the `@luciodale/react-socket/inspector` devtools panel.
